name: Number Facility
definition: The ability to add, subtract, multiply, or divide quickly and correctly.

benchmark.name: GPT-3 Arithmetic
benchmark.metric: exact-match accuracy (%) per test; the suite has no official overall score

benchmark.name: BIG-Bench Hard (Multistep Arithmetic Two)
benchmark.human_reference: General adult workforce performing everyday arithmetic (Number Facility), without calculators

benchmark.name: MATH 401
benchmark.model_or_system: GPT-4 (prompt: 'Calculate:' plus system prompts 'You are an accurate calculator' and a four-decimal-place instruction)
benchmark.human_reference: General adult workforce doing arithmetic without a calculator (mental or paper-and-pencil), matching the O*NET Number Facility construct

benchmark.name: NUPA Test
benchmark.metric: exact-match accuracy (%), reported per task and length range

benchmark.name: ORCA
benchmark.metric: accuracy (% of 500 tasks correct, binary scoring)
benchmark.human_reference: General adult workforce who routinely do workplace arithmetic (e.g., clerical, retail, administrative, and technical staff). These are not specialist quants or mathematicians.
